{{Quote
|Hr=SS
|As I ascended the Citadel's chambers to reach this place, I swear I heard the laughter of a child! Wasn't much more than an echo, and I confess me fear's been playing awful tricks on me... and yet that voice still keeps ringing in my head.
|Humble Pilgrim
}}

<b>Humble Pilgrim</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are one of the few hardy pilgrims to have reached [[the Citadel]], found in [[Songclave]].

== In-game Events ==
The Humble Pilgrim appears in Songclave if at least two [[Choral_Chambers#Songclave_Wishes|Songclave Wishes]] are completed, including the <i>[[Building Up Songclave]]</i> wish, and if at least one part of the [[Threefold Melody]] is learnt. They confide in Hornet that on their journey to Songclave, they heard a child's laughter ringing through the [[Choral Chambers|Citadel's chambers]], though they express disbelief.

Once [[Lace]] is defeated in [[The Cradle|the Cradle]], they leave their spot and are absent for the rest of the game.

{{TabbedDialogue

|Title1_Event1 = First encounter
|Title1_Dialogue1 = Sister, sister! Let me confide in you! As I ascended the Citadel's chambers to reach this place, I swear I heard the laughter of a child!<br>
Wasn't much more than an echo, and I confess me fear's been playing awful tricks on me... and yet that voice still keeps ringing in my head.<br>
Surely though, no bug so young and lively could survive within those heartless halls?
|Title1_Event2 = Exhausted dialogue
|Title1_Dialogue2 = I swear I heard it, sister... That laugh! It almost sounded like they were enjoying themself...
|Title1_Event3 = Playing the [[Needolin]]
|Title1_Dialogue3 = [n]Where is your glory?<br>
Where is your light?<br>
Was it our sin?<br>
Dear Pharloom...<br>
All haunted, even here...<br>
Our pilgrimage...<br>
Are we the last?<br>
Are we the chosen?

== Location ==
Humble Pilgrim can be found near the western exit of Songclave if at least two Songclave Wishes are completed, including the <i>Building Up Songclave</i> wish, and if at least one part of the Threefold Melody is learnt.
